answer: Every new identity needs a sponsor, an established identity that locks 500,000 POA for 30 epochs per child and burns 5% of it, 25,000 POA, when the child joins. A sponsor holds at most 4 live children, so 1,000 fakes need 250 sponsors, 500 million POA locked and 25 million burned for sure. If a child fails a challenge, 100,000 more burns, so lending coins to fakes means gambling them. A lock is tied to one child. A spiral of accounts sponsoring each other fails, since only established identities may sponsor. A tide of newcomers pays the same, released at dawn after epoch 30.
